profile.summary: I help make the web easy to use.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Making Commercial Real Estate easy and fun to use.

positions.title: Senior Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Architecture lead for CSS module system

• Architecture lead for Angular implementation

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Migrated front-end build system to Gulp.js

• Extended build system functionality to generate Angular modules, build sprite
maps, lint code, package html into a template cache, and generate documentation

• Reduced javascript http requests by 93% (31 files to 2) and size by 87% (1.6mb to
207kb) by pruning dead code, consolidating redundant functionality,
concatenating, and minifying

• Managed open.ieee.org and revised architecture to use json data and html
templates

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
• Transformed static mocks into modular code

• Managed architecture and organization of front-end assets

•  Refined user flows and experiences in collaboration with UI Designer

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Built mobile version of spectrum.ieee.org using Mobify.js

•  Revamped unused wiki and promoted its use by funneling communication and
reference documents through it

• Increased designer/developer productivity by leveraging javascript templates to
decouple data and html

• Rewrote CSS stack using LESS, reducing net production of CSS by 70% (482kb to
145kb)

• Automated generation of CSS from LESS and minification/optimization of front-end
assets by integrating Grunt.js task runner

positions.title: User Experience Architect
positions.description:
• Responsible for the behavior and interaction layer of company’s flagship platform

• Produced interactive prototypes via HTML/CSS/Javascript

• Conducted user tests to validate user flows and utility of designs

• Collaborated with external design firm to produce reusable front-end assets

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Introduced UI prototyping segment to Agile process increasing the frequency of user testing producing UI assets

• Introduced tooltip framework to simplify implementation of multi-step interactions

positions.title: Disaster Recovery Administrator
positions.description:
• Managed server and database for disaster recovery management and planning
software

• Supported 60+ users with account and functionality issues.

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Revised security model to sync levels of information clearance with company’s
authorization structure

• Authored document on best practices for disaster planning in collaboration with
departmental managers

positions.title: Operations Analyst
positions.description:
• Maintained business continuity by ensuring back up and transport of data from
100+ servers

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
• Designed an Access database to effectively monitor on-site/off-site transaction of
media tapes, replacing a manual entry system and increasing efficiency by 500%

•  Developed an excel worksheet template using VBA to automate the calculation of
performance statistics and replace the existing manual system

•  Developed and implemented screen capture software to record procedures,
accelerating the learning rate of new hires

•  Served as Project Lead in the deployment of the new backup infrastructure
consisting of 150+ servers backed up over a fiber channel into a StorageTek L700
silo housing 6 LTO2 tape drives
